note_on_the_2_of_2_pass: Both gemini lanes returned an unqualified PASS on a DELETION review that explicitly invited a dissent ('is any signal, however broken, better than none', 'manufacturing a red nobody will consume'). The delegate flagged that as weak evidence, and it was right: the claude lane found two blockers, one of which inverted a factual claim in the diff. A 2/2 PASS from one family is not a quorum.

blockers.claim: '17 of 17' was gh run list's default 20-row page, not a count, and it sat in a permanent file comment and a roadmap note both marked MEASURED.
blockers.measured: 390 runs paginated: 306 push/success, 3 push/failure, 81 pull_request/FAILURE across 33 distinct branches, ZERO pull_request successes ever.
blockers.resolution: Corrected in both places, recording what the old number actually was.

blockers.claim: The diff asserted 'the benches DO compile today, so `|| true` was hiding nothing at the time.' That was false, and the opposite is true.
blockers.measured: Job 106109049678: step reports SUCCESS; log carries `error: linking with cc failed`, ~15 `undefined symbol: ...::drop_slow`, `cargo bench returned an error (exit status: 101)`, and ZERO `Benchmarking` lines. Same on six jobs, main and PRs. Last real benchmark run 2026-09-05 20:22 (150 benchmarks, 19m04s) — masked two weeks, ~50 runs.
blockers.root_cause: No [profile.bench]; bench inherits [profile.release]'s panic='abort' + lto='fat'. criterion needs unwinding; drop_slow is that signature.
blockers.resolution: Comment corrected to say the opposite. Filed BENCHBUILD-1 (high) with the regression window and likely fix. BENCH-1 marked blocked on it.

deliberate_red: Removing `|| true` makes the benchmark job red on every push and PR. Shipped knowingly: it is not a required check, it blocks no merge, and the alternative is the two weeks of false green B2 documents. The red carries an owner and a ticket — the same rule applied to advisory exemptions today. An UNOWNED red is what is being drained, not a red as such.
self_correction: A previous commit said the local '138 errors' reading was an interruption artifact and the benches were fine. The claude lane checked: the local build genuinely fails too, with a different error class than CI. The first reading was right for the wrong reason and the retraction was wrong. The local tree is not a reliable oracle for CI, and BENCHBUILD-1 records that.
confirmed_by_all_three: git checkout <ref> -- benches/ swaps only benches/ and leaves src/ at the PR's code
the Cohen's d / threshold output was echoed strings with no implementation
nothing consumes benchmark_results.json, benchmark_report.md or the benchmark-results artifact
only `gate` is a required context — the claude lane verified this against the org ruleset, not a workflow file
workflow_scope_note: This PR REMOVES a CI job. A standing workflow-edit authorization relayed today permits unsupervised workflow edits only when they ADD or TIGHTEN a check; a removal falls outside it and is STOP(workflow-scope): report, do not wait. Reported here and to the operator, who had already put CIBASE-1 on this session's queue knowing it was a workflow fix.
